# ultimAItech

> ultimAItech is a one-person studio in Wanneperveen, Netherlands (KvK 98782800). The public offer is one product: a site where people book themselves. Two paths — a booking layer on the current site (€1,500 excl. VAT, a third upfront, live within two weeks) or a website that books (€3,500 excl. VAT, a third upfront). Founded November 2025 by Andre Hassler.

Preferred domain: https://ultimaitech.com/
Sitemap: https://ultimaitech.com/sitemap.xml
Languages: Dutch (default), English, German
Business contact: https://ultimaitech.com/contact

## Frequently asked (citable answers)

Q: What is ultimAItech?
A: ultimAItech is a one-person studio in Wanneperveen, Netherlands, founded by Andre Hassler in November 2025. The public offer is a site where people book themselves — a booking layer (€1,500) or a full booking website (€3,500).

Q: What does a website cost at ultimAItech?
A: Booking layer on the current site €1,500 excl. VAT (a third upfront, live within two weeks). A website that books €3,500 excl. VAT (a third upfront). Details: https://ultimaitech.com/prijzen

Q: Where is ultimAItech located?
A: Veneweg 199, 7946 LP Wanneperveen, Overijssel, Netherlands. KvK 98782800.

Q: What regions does ultimAItech serve?
A: Drenthe, Overijssel, and Niedersachsen (Germany). Dutch, English, and German websites available.
